title: OpenAI documentation versus the ACP specification, a snapshot before the 2026-11-13 rewrite
caption: Five points where OpenAI's ACP implementation docs, as read on 2026-10-11 and re-confirmed on 2026-10-20, differed from the 2026-04-17 spec. OpenAI replaced those docs on 2026-11-13 with its Commerce in ChatGPT playbook, which describes none of these points, so the right column is history. The spec column still holds.
alt: Side-by-side list. Spec: feed paths /feeds; webhooks order_create and order_update; complete returns 200; idempotency_conflict is 422; TLS 1.3 required. OpenAI ACP docs as read 2026-10-11 and rewritten 2026-11-13: feed paths /product_feeds plus a promotions API; webhooks order_created and order_updated; complete returns 201 Created; idempotency_conflict is 409; TLS 1.2 or later. Each pair is marked as having differed.

sourceOfTruth.label: OpenAI's ACP docs before the 2026-11-13 rewrite (archived) and the ACP 2026-04-17 spec
